label: Approval Config
title: Approval Config
subtitle: Manages approval levels for tools and their methods. Agents can programmatically adjust which operations require user review, notify-only, or run automatically.
whenToUse: Used in workflows that need to dynamically change approval requirements — for example, raising all tool approvals to Ask at the start of a sensitive phase, then lowering them when done.

methods.name: Get Config
methods.description: Returns the current approval configuration for all tools and methods.

methods.name: Set Tool Approval
methods.description: Sets the approval level (auto/notify/ask/disabled) for an entire tool.

methods.name: Set Method Approval
methods.description: Sets the approval level for a specific method within a tool.

mediaCaption: An Approval Config action card showing the tool name, method, and the new approval level being set
